subject: Error in installing shinyapps package from github

messages.author: f7d56dedd8804193
messages.subject: Error in installing shinyapps package from github
parts:
I am trying to install the `shinyapps` package from its development page at Github to deploy my application to the `shinyapps.io` service. I am using the this code as described in [http://shiny.rstudio.com/articles/shinyapps.html][1]

    devtools::install_github('rstudio/shinyapps')

However, I am getting the following error message:

    Downloading github repo rstudio/shinyapps@master
    Error in function (type, msg, asError = TRUE)  : 
    Failed to connect to api.github.com port 443: Connection refused

Any idea about why and how to solve this issue?
